title: M-02877: pr-reviewer-automerge launchd agent
intent: PRs that pr-reviewer reviewed at their current head merge automatically, as the gh identity, when they are not held, by worldofgeese/github-actions/dependabot, threads resolved, checks green, mergeable, and without manual before-you-merge steps
proof_hooks: darwin system builds; shellcheck passes on pr-reviewer-automerge
dry run lists merges and skip reasons without merging
live agent merged devrel-infra#319 and #331 and community#110 at their reviewed heads, and conference-dashboard#429 with --squash from repo settings
